text.inkscape:label: Crazy as a Loon
text.tspan: Once per game, as a desperate measure, the player may activate this ability. It is declared at the start of a turn, before any characters are
activated. The ability ignores the need for the Desperado player’s characters to take Nerve tests for the whole turn; even a “Yellow Belly” card
won’t work on them. Use a marker to denote Nerve tests that have been “dodged” in this manner. At the end of the turn, roll a D10 for each of
these “dodged” tests; any rolls of 1-5 count as failed and hit markers are applied. Naturally, this may result in a lot of folks dropping dead at
the end of the turn.

text.inkscape:label: A Hog Killin' Time
text.tspan: May be used once per turn at the end of a pistol armed character’s actions, as long as the character is not benefiting from substantial cover.
The player may declare that the character is taking a further, bonus Shoot action. Apply all normal modifers to the shot (there is no additional
modifer to this fourth shot), resolve the action and then place an Under fire marker on the shooter. This may result in your own character going
out of action.

text.inkscape:label: Life Ain't Worth Spit
text.tspan: Desperados may shoot into Hand to Hand fights. To shoot into Hand to Hand, simply declare actions and roll the dice as normal. Randomise
which character is hit with each successful shot by drawing a card from the deck. An even card (2, 4, 6, 8, or 10) indicates a friendly character
is hit, any other card indicates an opposing character is hit. Desperados also ignore the Nerve test required when the Outlaw “Hostage” card is
played (randomise the hit as described above).
At least half of the faction must be armed with a pistol as their sole ranged weapon. If mounted Characters are permitted in the Scene, then one
mounted Character may be equipped with a lasso. “A Hog Killin’ Time” and “Crazy as a Loon” may not be used in the same turn; only one is
permitted to be played in a single turn. “Life Ain’t Worth Spit” is used all of the time.
DesperadoS
